notes.notes:
Hi All,

Hope you have enjoyed our special and unique visual novel/dating sim.

Full menu restored  with new game options such as auto-read speed.

Included further instructions on how to skip.

Minor cosmetic and aesthetic fixes.

Thanks for all the support and feedback.

Sapphire Dragon Productions Team
